hero.lead.zh: 盛楷农业科技有限公司（Sycamore Agritech Limited）在马拉维经营规模化农场，采用中心支轴式喷灌种植小麦，同时种植高粱，并按种子生产标准开展玉米制种。我们拥有成套现代农业机械，既用于自有农场作业，也对外提供租赁服务。
hero.lead.en: Sycamore Agritech Limited runs large-scale farms in Malawi, growing wheat under centre-pivot irrigation, sorghum, and maize for seed production. We own a complete fleet of modern farm machinery, which we use on our own fields and also hire out.
hero.lead.note: Always write the company name in full: "Sycamore Agritech Limited" (never drop "Limited").

hero.tag.seed.note: maize grown to produce seed (hybrid seed production), NOT grain/commercial maize

biz.farming.text.zh: 灌溉小麦以及高粱和制种玉米，从整地到收储全程自主管理。
biz.farming.text.en: Wheat under irrigation, plus sorghum and seed maize, managed in-house from land preparation to storage.
biz.farming.text.note: do not imply sorghum is irrigated

biz.hire.text.zh: 拖拉机及整地、播种、植保、收获、灌溉机械，由我方机手操作，可到马拉维各地作业。
biz.hire.text.en: Tractors and machinery for land preparation, planting, spraying, harvesting and irrigation, run by our own operators anywhere in Malawi.
biz.hire.text.note: owner-confirmed 2026-10-10: ALL hired machines come with Sycamore's own operators (operated hire, never dry hire); service anywhere in Malawi

biz.supply.text.zh: 为面粉厂、酿造企业等客户稳定供应自产小麦和高粱。
biz.supply.text.en: A steady supply of our own wheat and sorghum for flour mills, breweries and other businesses.

farming.h2.zh: 我们的核心：规模化种植
farming.h2.en: At our core: farming at scale

farming.p1.zh: 种植是盛楷农业科技有限公司的核心业务。我们在马拉维的农场主要种植三种作物：小麦、高粱和制种玉米。小麦在凉爽旱季依靠灌溉种植，制种玉米按种子生产要求管理。农田配备中心支轴式和卷盘式喷灌设备，按作物生长阶段供水。
farming.p1.en: Farming is the heart of Sycamore Agritech Limited. Our farms in Malawi grow three main crops: wheat, sorghum and seed maize. The wheat is grown under irrigation through the cool dry season, and the maize is managed to seed-production standards. Our fields are equipped with centre-pivot and hose-reel irrigation, with water applied according to crop growth stage.
farming.p1.note: Always write the company name in full: "Sycamore Agritech Limited". Do not imply sorghum is irrigated.

farming.p2.zh: 我们的团队全程管理田间作业，从整地、播种、灌溉、施肥、植保到适时收获。主要作业环节由自有机械完成，力求每一季的产量和品质稳定可靠。
farming.p2.en: Our team manages the whole field cycle, from land preparation and planting to irrigation, fertilisation, crop protection and timely harvest. Key operations are done with our own machinery, helping to keep yield and quality consistent every season.

practice.pivot.text.zh: 大型喷灌机绕中心旋转，均匀覆盖整片农田，节水省工。
practice.pivot.text.en: Large pivots rotate around a central point, watering whole fields evenly while saving water and labour.

practice.care.text.zh: 按生长阶段安排施肥与植保，定期巡田，及早发现并处理问题。
practice.care.text.en: Fertiliser and crop protection timed to each growth stage, with regular field checks to catch problems early.

practice.mech.text.zh: 从深松、翻耕、精量播种到喷药，主要田间作业均由我们自有的机械完成。
practice.mech.text.en: From ripping and ploughing to precision planting and spraying, the key field operations are done with our own machinery.

practice.store.text.zh: 成熟后及时收获，清理、装袋后入库保存，保持干燥洁净。
practice.store.text.en: Crops are harvested at maturity, then cleaned, bagged and stored in dry, hygienic conditions.

farming.caption.zh: 清晨的小麦田，远处是中心支轴式喷灌机
farming.caption.en: Wheat at first light, with a centre pivot on the horizon

season.text.zh: 马拉维一年有两个主要种植季：雨季种植以玉米为主的雨养作物，凉爽旱季则依靠灌溉种植小麦等冬季作物。整地要赶在播种之前完成，这也是农机最紧张的时候。
season.text.en: Malawi has two main cropping seasons: rain-fed crops, mainly maize, in the rainy season, and irrigated winter crops such as wheat in the cool dry season. Land must be prepared before each planting, so that is when demand for machinery peaks.

season.note.zh: 按马拉维一般农时整理，各地区、各年份会有差异。资料来源：FEWS NET、FAO GIEWS、马拉维气候变化与气象服务局。
season.note.en: A general guide to Malawi's seasons; timing varies by region and year. Sources: FEWS NET, FAO GIEWS, Malawi Department of Climate Change and Meteorological Services.
season.note.note: keep organisation names; translate the Malawian department name naturally or keep it in English

irri.intro.zh: 马拉维的降雨集中在雨季，旱季种植离不开灌溉。我们的农田配备两类喷灌设备。
irri.intro.en: Malawi's rain falls mainly in one season, so dry-season farming depends on irrigation. Our fields use two types of sprinkler irrigation.

irri.pivot.text.zh: 多跨喷灌机以中心点为轴缓慢旋转，一台设备即可均匀覆盖一大片圆形农田，适合大面积连片种植的小麦。
irri.pivot.text.en: A multi-span machine turns slowly around a central point, watering a large circular area evenly. It is well suited to our broad wheat fields.

irri.reel.text.zh: 卷盘回收软管时牵引喷头车在田间行走，逐条完成喷灌；设备可在不同地块间转移，用于补充灌溉，也可对外租赁。
irri.reel.text.en: As the hose winds back onto the reel, it pulls the sprinkler cart across the field, one strip at a time. The machine moves easily between fields for supplementary irrigation and is also available for hire.

crops.intro.zh: 这三种作物是我们农场的主力。
crops.intro.en: These three crops are the mainstay of our farms.

crops.wheat.text.zh: 在灌溉条件下种植，用于制粉和食品加工。马拉维所需小麦几乎全部依靠进口，发展本地种植有助于减少进口依赖。
crops.wheat.text.en: Grown under irrigation for flour milling and food processing. Malawi imports almost all of its wheat, so growing it locally helps reduce reliance on imports.

crops.seed.text.zh: 按制种要求种植和管理：隔离种植、及时去雄、田间去杂、单收单储，确保种子纯度和质量。
crops.seed.text.en: Grown to seed-production standards to protect seed purity and quality: isolated fields, timely detasselling, removal of off-type plants (roguing), and separate harvesting and storage.
crops.seed.text.note: technical seed-production terms: detasselling, roguing (removing off-type plants)

hire.h2.en: Professional farm machinery, when you need it

hire.lead.zh: 盛楷农业科技有限公司自有的成套农业机械覆盖整地、播种、植保、收获和灌溉等环节，同时对外出租。设备保养良好，每台都由我方有经验的机手操作，可派往马拉维任何地区，帮助农场、庄园和合作社不误农时。
hire.lead.en: Our own fleet of farm machinery is available for hire, covering land preparation, planting, spraying, harvesting and irrigation. The equipment is well maintained and every machine is run by one of our experienced operators. We work anywhere in Malawi, so farms, estates and cooperatives can get the work done on time.
hire.lead.note: zh starts with the Chinese company name; fr/pt may start with "Sycamore Agritech Limited" or "our" — meaning unchanged. owner-confirmed 2026-10-10: ALL hired machines come with Sycamore's own operators (operated hire, never dry hire); service anywhere in Malawi

hire.p2.zh: 在马拉维，人工用锄头整地每公顷需要 23–31 个工日，而机械整地（含起垄）每公顷只需约 2–2.5 小时。整地推迟两周，玉米最多可减产 30%。提前预约，以便透雨一到就能及时播种。
hire.p2.en: In Malawi, preparing one hectare with a hand hoe takes 23–31 person-days; with machinery, including ridging, it takes about 2–2.5 hours. A two-week delay in land preparation can cut maize yields by up to 30%. Book early so your land is ready when the planting rains arrive.

hire.source.zh: 数据来源：整地用时来自马拉维科技大学 / MwAPATA 研究所和 SIMLESA / 国际玉米小麦改良中心（CIMMYT）；减产幅度来自马拉维国家计划委员会与联合国开发计划署《马拉维 2063》政策简报（2022），该简报引用国际食物政策研究所（IFPRI）的研究。
hire.source.en: Sources: land-preparation times from Malawi University of Science and Technology / MwAPATA Institute and SIMLESA/CIMMYT; yield loss from Malawi National Planning Commission and UNDP, Malawi 2063 policy brief (2022), citing IFPRI.

hire.caption.zh: 圆盘犁在田间作业，后方是其他农机
hire.caption.en: A disc plough at work, with other machines behind

svc.prep.text.zh: 圆盘犁翻耕，深松机打破压实的犁底层。
svc.prep.text.en: Disc ploughing, plus subsoiling to break up compacted layers.

svc.plant.text.zh: 多行精量播种机，株距均匀、行距一致。
svc.plant.text.en: Multi-row precision planting for even seed and row spacing.

svc.spray.text.zh: 悬挂式喷杆喷雾机，用于大田除草和病虫害防治。
svc.spray.text.en: Tractor-mounted boom sprayers for weed, pest and disease control.

svc.harvest.text.zh: 自走式联合收割机，一次完成收割和脱粒，可收获玉米、高粱、小麦、大豆和水稻。
svc.harvest.text.en: A self-propelled combine that harvests and threshes in one pass, for maize, sorghum, wheat, soya beans and rice.
svc.harvest.text.note: owner-confirmed 2026-10-10: the combine currently harvests maize, sorghum, wheat, soybeans and rice

svc.irri.text.zh: 卷盘式喷灌机，可在地块之间转移，进行补充灌溉。
svc.irri.text.en: A hose-reel irrigator that moves between fields for supplementary watering.

svc.earth.text.zh: 履带式挖掘机，用于开沟、清障和农田基础设施建设。
svc.earth.text.en: A crawler excavator for digging ditches, clearing obstacles and other farm infrastructure work.

fleet.lovol.text.zh: 220 马力级四驱拖拉机，配驾驶室，适合牵引圆盘犁、深松机和大型播种机。
fleet.lovol.text.en: A 220 hp-class 4WD cab tractor for pulling disc ploughs, subsoilers and large planters.

fleet.tk.text.zh: 带遮阳顶棚的多用途拖拉机，适合播种、喷药、轻型耕作和田间运输。
fleet.tk.text.en: A versatile tractor with a sun canopy, for planting, spraying, light tillage and farm transport.

fleet.plough.text.zh: 配 7 片圆盘，适用于板结、干硬及秸秆较多地块的翻耕。
fleet.plough.text.en: A heavy seven-disc plough for primary tillage in hard, dry ground or fields with heavy crop residue.

fleet.sub.text.zh: 打破耕层下压实的犁底层，改善土壤渗水，促进根系生长。
fleet.sub.text.en: Breaks up compacted layers below plough depth, improving water infiltration and root growth.

fleet.planter.text.zh: 多行精量播种机，每个播种单体配独立种箱，适合玉米、大豆等中耕作物。
fleet.planter.text.en: A multi-row precision planter with a seed hopper on every row unit, for row crops such as maize and soya beans.

fleet.sprayer.text.zh: 液压折叠喷杆，用于喷施除草剂、杀虫剂、杀菌剂和叶面肥。
fleet.sprayer.text.en: Hydraulically folding booms for applying herbicides, insecticides, fungicides and foliar fertiliser.

fleet.combine.text.zh: 自走式谷物联合收割机，可收获玉米、高粱、小麦、大豆和水稻，图中为玉米割台。
fleet.combine.text.en: A self-propelled grain combine for maize, sorghum, wheat, soya beans and rice, shown here with a maize header.
fleet.combine.text.note: owner-confirmed 2026-10-10: the combine currently harvests maize, sorghum, wheat, soybeans and rice

fleet.reel.text.zh: 移动式喷灌设备，适合小麦、玉米、蔬菜和牧草的补充灌溉。
fleet.reel.text.en: A travelling sprinkler for supplementary irrigation of wheat, maize, vegetables and pasture.

fleet.exc.text.zh: 用于开挖灌溉沟渠、清理障碍、修建农场道路等土方工程。
fleet.exc.text.en: For digging irrigation channels, clearing obstacles, building farm roads and other earthworks.

hire.terms.zh: 租期、计费方式（按面积、按小时或按天）以及是否含燃油和运输，均可按需求商定，以报价为准。所有设备均由我方机手操作。
hire.terms.en: We agree the details case by case: the hire period, how charges are calculated (per hectare/acre, per hour or per day), and whether fuel and transport are included. Every machine comes with our own operator, and everything is confirmed in our quote.
hire.terms.note: owner-confirmed 2026-10-10: ALL hired machines come with Sycamore's own operators (operated hire, never dry hire); service anywhere in Malawi

band.text.zh: 整地和播种时节农机最紧张。告诉我们您的作业需求，我们会尽快确认排期。
band.text.en: Machinery is busiest during land preparation and planting. Tell us what you need and we'll confirm a slot as soon as possible.

supply.text.zh: 我们直接向企业客户供应自产的小麦和高粱，均按客户要求的规格交付；制种玉米则为种子企业生产。欢迎询价。
supply.text.en: We supply our own wheat and sorghum directly to business customers, to each customer's specification, and grow seed maize for seed companies. Ask us for a quote.

about.h2.en: Rooted in Malawi, built to last

about.p.zh: 盛楷农业科技有限公司（Sycamore Agritech Limited）总部位于马拉维首都利隆圭，业务涵盖规模化种植、农业机械租赁、小麦与高粱供应以及农产品贸易。Sycamore（梧桐）是一种根深叶茂的树，我们也希望像它一样扎根土地、稳健生长，与客户建立长期合作。
about.p.en: Sycamore Agritech Limited is based in Lilongwe, Malawi's capital, and works across large-scale farming, agricultural machinery hire, wheat and sorghum supply, and agricultural products trade. The sycamore is a broad, deep-rooted tree, and that is how we want to grow: rooted in the land, steady, and building long-term partnerships with our customers.

about.quote.en: “Plant a sycamore, and the phoenix will come.”
about.quote.note: Chinese proverb; fr use « », pt use « »

about.quoteFoot.zh: 把事情做扎实，好的合作伙伴自然会来。
about.quoteFoot.en: An old Chinese saying: build something worthwhile, and good partners will follow.

contact.text.en: Whether you're buying wheat, sorghum or other Malawi produce, discussing seed production or booking machinery, send us a message or call us, and we'll get back to you quickly.

faq.title.en: Tractor and machinery hire: common questions

faq.q1.en: Does a hired tractor come with an operator?
faq.q1.note: owner-confirmed 2026-10-10: ALL hired machines come with Sycamore's own operators (operated hire, never dry hire); service anywhere in Malawi

faq.a1.zh: 是的。我们出租的每台设备都配有我方有经验的机手负责操作，您无需自备驾驶员。
faq.a1.en: Yes. Every machine we hire out is run by one of our own experienced operators, so you don't need to provide a driver.
faq.a1.note: owner-confirmed 2026-10-10: ALL hired machines come with Sycamore's own operators (operated hire, never dry hire); service anywhere in Malawi

faq.q2.en: How are machinery hire charges calculated?

faq.a2.zh: 我们按作业内容、面积和地点报价，可按公顷/英亩、按小时或按天计费，并在报价中写明是否包含燃油和运输。
faq.a2.en: We quote according to the job, the area and the location: per hectare/acre, per hour or per day. The quote states clearly whether fuel and transport are included.

faq.q3.zh: 你们可以到马拉维哪些地区作业？
faq.q3.en: Which areas of Malawi do you cover?

faq.a3.zh: 马拉维全境都可以。我们的基地在利隆圭，可将设备和机手派往马拉维任何地区。请告诉我们地块位置，我们会确认排期，并在报价中写明运输安排。
faq.a3.en: Anywhere in Malawi. We are based in Lilongwe and can send machines and operators to any part of the country. Tell us where your fields are and we'll confirm the schedule and set out the transport arrangements in our quote.
faq.a3.note: owner-confirmed 2026-10-10: ALL hired machines come with Sycamore's own operators (operated hire, never dry hire); service anywhere in Malawi

faq.q4.en: How far ahead should I book?

faq.a4.zh: 越早越好。整地和播种时节农机最紧张，建议在雨季开始前尽早预约。
faq.a4.en: As early as possible. Land preparation and planting are our busiest times, so we recommend booking well before the rains start.

faq.q5.zh: 联合收割机可以收获哪些作物？
faq.q5.en: Which crops can the combine harvester handle?

faq.a5.zh: 我们的联合收割机目前可收获玉米、高粱、小麦、大豆和水稻。请告诉我们作物、面积和地块位置，我们会确认排期并报价。
faq.a5.en: Our combine can currently harvest maize, sorghum, wheat, soya beans and rice. Tell us the crop, the area and where your fields are, and we'll confirm a slot and send a quote.
faq.a5.note: owner-confirmed 2026-10-10: the combine currently harvests maize, sorghum, wheat, soybeans and rice

tp.desc.zh: 马拉维农产品出口：盛楷农业科技有限公司在利隆圭为海内外买家采购供应木豆、花生、芝麻、澳洲坚果（夏威夷果）、大豆、辣椒、咖啡等，负责分级、SGS 检验、出口单证和运输。
tp.desc.en: Malawi agricultural products for export: pigeon peas, groundnuts, sesame, macadamia and more from Sycamore Agritech Limited, with SGS inspection and export papers.
tp.desc.note: SEO meta description (140–165 chars). owner-confirmed 2026-10-10: SGS inspection can be arranged; name SGS directly (not 'SGS or similar')

tp.h1.zh: 马拉维本地农产品，面向全球买家
tp.h1.en: Malawi-grown agricultural products for buyers worldwide

tp.lead.zh: 盛楷农业科技有限公司立足马拉维利隆圭，依托自有农场和本地种植者网络，为海内外客户采购并供应马拉维出产的各类农产品：豆类、油料、坚果、谷物、香料和特色产品。从寻源、分级、包装到出口单证和运输，马拉维这一端的工作由我们全程负责。
tp.lead.en: Sycamore Agritech Limited is based in Lilongwe, Malawi. Drawing on our own farms and a network of local growers, we source and supply Malawi-grown agricultural products to customers at home and abroad: pulses, oilseeds, nuts, grains, spices and specialty products. From sourcing, grading and packing to export documents and transport, we take care of the Malawi end.
tp.lead.note: Company name: zh uses 盛楷农业科技有限公司; fr/pt/en use "Sycamore Agritech Limited" in full.

tp.tag2.note: chip. owner-confirmed 2026-10-10: SGS inspection can be arranged; name SGS directly (not 'SGS or similar')

tp.tag4.en: Service in Chinese, English, French and Portuguese

tp.whyEyebrow.zh: 为什么从我们这里采购

tp.whyH2.zh: 一个在马拉维当地的可靠伙伴
tp.whyH2.en: A reliable partner on the ground in Malawi

tp.whyIntro.zh: 隔着万里采购农产品，最怕货不对板、单证缺失、交期拖延。我们就在产地，这些问题由我们来解决。
tp.whyIntro.en: Buying farm produce from thousands of kilometres away, the worries are the same everywhere: goods that do not match the sample, missing paperwork and late shipments. We are at the origin, and we solve those problems for you.

tw1.title.zh: 来自马拉维的产地直供
tw1.title.en: Grown in Malawi, supplied at origin

tw1.text.zh: 货源来自我们自有的农场和长期合作的马拉维种植者，每一批货物的产地、批次和供应商都有记录。
tw1.text.en: Our supply comes from our own farms and from Malawian growers we work with season after season; every lot is recorded with its origin, batch and supplier.

tw2.title.en: Every lot checked before it ships

tw2.text.zh: 按合同规格抽样检验：水分、杂质、粒度分级；花生等产品可提供经认可实验室出具的黄曲霉毒素检测报告。我们还可安排 SGS 装运前检验。
tw2.text.en: Lots are sampled and checked against the contract: moisture, foreign matter and grading. For groundnuts and similar products we provide aflatoxin test reports from an accredited laboratory. We can also arrange SGS pre-shipment inspection.
tw2.text.note: owner-confirmed 2026-10-10: SGS inspection can be arranged; name SGS directly (not 'SGS or similar')

tw3.text.zh: 出口许可、植物检疫证书、原产地证书、海关申报和马拉维储备银行的出口申报，都在马拉维这一端完成，您收到的是一套完整的单证。
tw3.text.en: Export licence, phytosanitary certificate, certificate of origin, customs declaration and the Reserve Bank export declaration are all completed on the Malawi side, so you receive one complete set of documents.

tw4.text.zh: 马拉维是最不发达国家，马拉维原产的农产品进入中国享受零关税，进入欧盟和英国享受免关税、免配额待遇；在非洲区域内可享受 SADC、COMESA 和 AfCFTA 优惠。
tw4.text.en: As goods of Malawian origin from a least-developed country, our products enter China tariff-free and the European Union and United Kingdom duty-free and quota-free, with SADC, COMESA and AfCFTA preferences within Africa.

tp.catH2.zh: 我们可以供应的马拉维农产品
tp.catH2.en: Malawi agricultural products we can supply

tp.catIntro.zh: 以下是我们经常采购供应的品类。具体品种、规格、等级、包装和起订量按您的要求报价，目录之外的马拉维农产品也欢迎询价。
tp.catIntro.en: These are the products we regularly source and supply. Varieties, specifications, grades, packing and minimum quantities are quoted to your requirements, and we welcome enquiries for other Malawi-grown products too.

tp.catNote.zh: 各产品标注的月份为新季货源的一般供应期。部分产品（如玉米、大豆、食糖）的出口受马拉维政府许可和季节性管制，我们会在签约前确认当期政策。
tp.catNote.en: The months shown are the usual supply window for new-crop goods. Exports of some products (for example maize, soybeans and sugar) are subject to Malawi government licensing and seasonal restrictions, which we confirm before any contract is signed.

prod.pigeonpea.text.zh: 马拉维主要的出口豆类，整粒干木豆，印度和南亚加工商的常规采购品种。
prod.pigeonpea.text.en: Malawi's main export pulse: whole dry pigeon peas (tur), bought regularly by processors in India and South Asia.

prod.groundnut.text.zh: CG7、Chalimbana 等品种，脱壳花生仁按客户要求分级，可提供黄曲霉毒素检测报告。
prod.groundnut.text.en: CG7 and Chalimbana varieties; shelled kernels graded to your specification, with aflatoxin test reports available.

prod.soybean.text.zh: 非转基因大豆，供榨油、饲料和食品加工；出口需政府许可，接单前确认。
prod.soybean.text.en: Non-GMO soybeans for crushing, feed and food processing; exports require a government licence, which we confirm before taking an order.

prod.beans.text.en: Red kidney beans, sugar beans and other dry beans.

prod.cowpea.text.zh: 干豇豆，供应区域及海外食品市场。
prod.cowpea.text.en: Dried cowpeas for food markets in the region and overseas.

prod.sesame.text.zh: 白芝麻，清选后装袋，适合榨油和食品加工。
prod.sesame.text.en: Natural whitish sesame, cleaned and bagged, for oil and food use.

prod.macadamia.text.zh: 带壳果和果仁，按国际通行的果仁规格分级。
prod.macadamia.text.en: Nut-in-shell and kernels, graded to the international kernel styles.

prod.cotton.text.zh: 轧花后的皮棉，供纺纱厂。
prod.cotton.text.en: Ginned cotton lint for spinning mills.

prod.rice.text.zh: Kilombero 长粒香米等马拉维优质品种。
prod.rice.text.en: Kilombero long-grain aromatic rice and other Malawian varieties.

prod.sorghum.text.zh: 来自我们自有农场和合作种植者，供酿造、食品和饲料。
prod.sorghum.text.en: From our own farms and partner growers, for brewing, food and feed.

prod.maize.text.zh: 白玉米（非转基因），出口受政府季节性管制，以下单时的政策为准。
prod.maize.text.en: White non-GMO maize; exports depend on seasonal government rules, confirmed at the time of order.

prod.chilli.text.zh: 马拉维著名的干鸟眼椒（peri-peri），辣度高。
prod.chilli.text.en: Malawi's well-known dried African bird's-eye (peri-peri) chillies, high in pungency.

prod.paprika.text.zh: 干甜椒荚和甜椒粉，供香料和食品加工。
prod.paprika.text.en: Dried paprika pods and powder for spice and food processing.

prod.coffee.text.zh: 马拉维北部高地的水洗阿拉比卡咖啡生豆。
prod.coffee.text.en: Washed Arabica green beans from Malawi's northern highlands.

prod.tea.text.zh: 马拉维南部茶区的 CTC 红茶，标准等级。
prod.tea.text.en: CTC black tea from the estates of southern Malawi, in standard grades.

prod.sugar.text.zh: 马拉维蔗糖，受出口许可管理，按可用配额供应。
prod.sugar.text.en: Malawian cane sugar, subject to export permits and available allocations.

prod.honey.text.zh: 米翁博林区的天然蜂蜜，按合同小批量供应。
prod.honey.text.en: Natural honey from the miombo woodlands, in smaller contract lots.

prod.cassava.text.en: Dried cassava chips and cassava flour.

prod.mango.text.zh: 应季鲜芒果及芒果制品。
prod.mango.text.en: Seasonal fresh mango and mango products.

prod.vegetables.text.zh: 旱季灌溉蔬菜，主要面向周边市场。
prod.vegetables.text.en: Dry-season irrigated vegetables, mainly for regional markets.

tp.calIntro.zh: 马拉维雨季作物多在 4–6 月收获，新季货源 6–9 月最充足；多年生作物各有周期。下图为主要产品的收获期和新季供应期。
tp.calIntro.en: Rain-fed crops in Malawi are mostly harvested from April to June, so new-crop supply is at its best from June to September; tree crops follow their own cycles. The chart shows the harvest and new-crop supply periods of our main products.

tp.calNote.zh: 按马拉维一般农时整理，不同年份和产区会有差异。资料来源：FEWS NET、FAO GIEWS 及马拉维行业机构。
tp.calNote.en: A general guide based on Malawi's usual seasons; timing varies by year and region. Sources: FEWS NET, FAO GIEWS and Malawian industry bodies.

tp.howH2.zh: 从询价到交货，六个步骤
tp.howH2.en: From enquiry to delivery in six steps

tp.howIntro.zh: 我们按国际农产品贸易的通行做法操作，每一步都清楚透明。
tp.howIntro.en: We follow the usual practice of international commodity trade, and keep every step clear.

tstep1.text.zh: 告诉我们产品、规格、数量、目的港和希望的贸易术语。
tstep1.text.en: Tell us the product, specification, quantity, destination port and preferred Incoterm.

tstep2.text.zh: 我们报价并寄送代表性样品，供您检验。
tstep2.text.en: We send an offer and a representative sample for your evaluation.

tstep3.text.zh: 确认规格、包装、交期和付款方式，签订销售合同。
tstep3.text.en: We agree specification, packing, delivery time and payment terms, and sign the sales contract.

tstep4.text.zh: 在马拉维采购、清选、分级并按合同包装。
tstep4.text.en: We source, clean, grade and pack the goods in Malawi to the contract.

tstep5.text.zh: 装运前检验（可安排 SGS），办理出口许可、植物检疫证书、原产地证书和海关手续。
tstep5.text.en: Pre-shipment inspection, by SGS if you wish, then export licence, phytosanitary certificate, certificate of origin and customs clearance.
tstep5.text.note: owner-confirmed 2026-10-10: SGS inspection can be arranged; name SGS directly (not 'SGS or similar')

tstep6.text.zh: 货物经陆路运至港口装船，我们跟踪到货并发送全套单据。
tstep6.text.en: Goods travel overland to the port and are shipped; we track the consignment and send you the full document set.

term.incoterms.text.zh: 可按 EXW 利隆圭、FCA/FOB 贝拉或纳卡拉港、CFR/CIF 目的港报价（Incoterms® 2020）。
term.incoterms.text.en: We quote EXW Lilongwe, FCA/FOB Beira or Nacala, or CFR/CIF your destination port (Incoterms® 2020).

term.payment.text.zh: 新客户通常采用不可撤销即期信用证；长期客户可采用电汇预付定金、凭装运单据付余款。具体以合同约定为准。
term.payment.text.en: For new customers, usually an irrevocable letter of credit at sight; for repeat business, a telegraphic-transfer deposit with the balance against shipping documents. Terms are set in each contract.

term.packaging.text.zh: 25 kg 或 50 kg PP 编织袋、1 吨吨袋；果仁类可按要求真空包装；按 20 英尺集装箱整柜发运。
term.packaging.text.en: 25 kg or 50 kg woven PP bags or 1-tonne big bags; vacuum packing for kernels on request; shipped as full 20-foot container loads.

term.moq.text.zh: 通常为一个 20 英尺集装箱；部分产品可接受较小的试单。
term.moq.text.en: Usually one 20-foot container; smaller trial lots are possible for some products.

term.samples.text.zh: 签约前可通过快递寄送代表性样品。
term.samples.text.en: Representative samples can be couriered before you commit to a contract.

term.inspection.text.zh: 可安排 SGS 装运前检验和监装；水分、杂质和黄曲霉毒素等指标可由经认可的实验室出具报告。
term.inspection.text.en: We can arrange SGS pre-shipment inspection and loading supervision; moisture, foreign matter and aflatoxin results are reported by an accredited laboratory.
term.inspection.text.note: owner-confirmed 2026-10-10: SGS inspection can be arranged; name SGS directly (not 'SGS or similar')

tp.logH2.zh: 从内陆的马拉维，发往世界各地
tp.logH2.en: From landlocked Malawi to ports worldwide

tp.logIntro.zh: 马拉维是内陆国，货物经公路或铁路运到莫桑比克、坦桑尼亚或南非的港口装船。我们根据目的地、季节和货量为您选择最合适的通道。
tp.logIntro.en: Malawi is landlocked: goods travel by road or rail to ports in Mozambique, Tanzania or South Africa. We choose the corridor that suits your destination, the season and the volume.

corr.nacala.port.zh: 莫桑比克 · 纳卡拉港

corr.nacala.text.zh: 从利隆圭卡宁戈（Kanengo）货运站有铁路直通纳卡拉深水港，约 1,000 公里，也可走公路。适合整柜大宗货物。
corr.nacala.text.en: Rail from the Kanengo railhead in Lilongwe straight to the deep-water port of Nacala, about 1,000 km, with a road alternative. Well suited to full-container bulk cargo.

corr.beira.text.zh: 经德扎（Dedza）—太特（Tete）公路约 950 公里到贝拉港，是马拉维最主要的出海通道之一，有定期航线通往亚洲、中东和欧洲。
corr.beira.text.en: About 950 km by road via Dedza and Tete to the port of Beira, one of Malawi's main gateways, with regular sailings to Asia, the Middle East and Europe.

corr.dar.port.zh: 坦桑尼亚 · 达累斯萨拉姆港

corr.dar.text.zh: 经松圭（Songwe）口岸北上约 1,700 公里，是通往东亚和海湾地区的另一条通道。
corr.dar.text.en: North through the Songwe border crossing, about 1,700 km, an alternative route for East Asia and the Gulf.

corr.air.port.zh: 利隆圭 · 卡穆祖国际机场

corr.air.text.zh: 样品和小批量生鲜产品可从利隆圭卡穆祖国际机场经亚的斯亚贝巴或内罗毕中转空运。
corr.air.text.en: Samples and small lots of perishable produce fly from Kamuzu International Airport, Lilongwe, with connections via Addis Ababa or Nairobi.

tp.logNote.zh: 运输时间视通道、季节和船期而定，德班港也可作为备选。每份报价都会写明建议路线和预计交期。
tp.logNote.en: Transit times depend on the corridor, the season and sailing schedules; Durban is a further option. Every offer states the proposed route and the expected delivery time.

tp.docsIntro.zh: 每批货物随附下列单证，按目的国要求和信用证条款准备。
tp.docsIntro.en: Every consignment ships with the documents below, prepared to the requirements of the destination country and the letter of credit.

doc.phyto.text.zh: 由马拉维植物保护主管机构（农业研究服务局 DARS）检验后签发。
doc.phyto.text.en: Issued after inspection by Malawi's plant protection authority, the Department of Agricultural Research Services (DARS).

doc.origin.text.zh: 由马拉维工商会（MCCCI）签发；SADC、COMESA 优惠原产地证由马拉维税务局签发。
doc.origin.text.en: Issued by the Malawi Confederation of Chambers of Commerce and Industry (MCCCI); SADC and COMESA preferential certificates by the Malawi Revenue Authority.

doc.quality.text.zh: 等级、水分、杂质和黄曲霉毒素等检测报告，由经认可的实验室或 SGS 出具。
doc.quality.text.en: Grade, moisture, foreign-matter and aflatoxin reports from an accredited laboratory or SGS.
doc.quality.text.note: owner-confirmed 2026-10-10: SGS inspection can be arranged; name SGS directly (not 'SGS or similar')

doc.fumig.text.zh: 按目的国要求对集装箱或货垛熏蒸并出具证书。
doc.fumig.text.en: Container or stack fumigation with a certificate, where the destination country requires it.

doc.invoice.text.zh: 与合同一致，注明 HS 编码、净毛重、袋数和批号。
doc.invoice.text.en: Matching the contract, with HS codes, net and gross weights, bag counts and lot numbers.

doc.transport.text.zh: 海运提单或公路运单；出口许可和海关申报由我们在马拉维办理。
doc.transport.text.en: Ocean bill of lading or road consignment note; the export licence and customs declaration are handled by us in Malawi.

tp.buyersH2.zh: 面向进口商、加工商和贸易商

tp.buyersText.zh: 无论您是首次从非洲采购，还是在寻找稳定的第二货源，我们都愿意从一个试单开始。
tp.buyersText.en: Whether you are buying from Africa for the first time or looking for a dependable second source, we are happy to start with a trial order.

buyer.importers.zh: 农产品进口商与分销商

buyer.processors.zh: 食品、油脂和坚果加工企业

buyer.regional.zh: 非洲区域市场的批发商

tfaq.title.zh: 从马拉维进口农产品：常见问题

tfaq.q1.en: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ)?

tfaq.a1.zh: 通常为一个 20 英尺集装箱。部分产品可以接受较小的试单，请直接询问。
tfaq.a1.en: Usually one 20-foot container. For some products we accept smaller trial lots; just ask.

tfaq.a2.zh: 可以。签约前我们可以通过快递寄送代表性样品，正式货物按约定规格供应。
tfaq.a2.en: Yes. Before any contract we can courier a representative sample, and the shipment is supplied to the agreed specification.

tfaq.q3.en: Which payment terms do you accept?

tfaq.a3.zh: 新客户通常采用不可撤销即期信用证；合作稳定后可采用电汇预付定金、凭装运单据付余款。
tfaq.a3.en: New customers usually pay by irrevocable letter of credit at sight; established customers by telegraphic-transfer deposit with the balance against shipping documents.

tfaq.q4.en: What is the lead time from order to shipment?

tfaq.a4.zh: 取决于产品、季节和通道。收到定金或信用证后，我们会确认采购、检验、单证和内陆运输的时间表，并在报价中写明预计交期。
tfaq.a4.en: It depends on the product, the season and the corridor. Once the deposit or letter of credit is in place we confirm a schedule for sourcing, inspection, documents and inland transport, and every offer states the expected delivery time.

tfaq.q5.zh: 可以安排 SGS 商检吗？
tfaq.q5.note: owner-confirmed 2026-10-10: SGS inspection can be arranged; name SGS directly (not 'SGS or similar')

tfaq.a5.zh: 可以。我们可安排 SGS 进行装运前检验和监装，费用在报价中列明。
tfaq.a5.en: Yes. We can arrange pre-shipment inspection and loading supervision by SGS, with the cost shown in the offer.
tfaq.a5.note: owner-confirmed 2026-10-10: SGS inspection can be arranged; name SGS directly (not 'SGS or similar')

tfaq.q6.zh: 马拉维对农产品出口有限制吗？
tfaq.q6.en: Are there export restrictions on agricultural products in Malawi?

tfaq.a6.zh: 有。玉米、大豆、食糖等部分产品需要政府出口许可，并可能受季节性限制。我们会在签约前确认当期政策，只承诺能够合法出口的货物。
tfaq.a6.en: Yes. Some products, such as maize, soybeans and sugar, need a government export licence and may face seasonal restrictions. We confirm the current rules before signing and only commit to goods that can legally be exported.

tp.band.title.zh: 告诉我们您要采购什么
tp.band.title.en: Tell us what you want to buy

tp.band.text.zh: 留下产品、数量和目的港，我们会尽快回复报价和供货季节。
tp.band.text.en: Send us the product, quantity and destination port, and we will reply with an offer and the supply season.

tag.rice.note: small tag chip, 1–2 words; the crop in the field (paddy), not milled rice
